card.share_text: Mulingo wa mpweya mu {{city}}: {{pm25}} µg/m³ ({{category}}) kudzera pa Mframapa AI
advice.good: Mpweya ndi wabwino. Sangalalani ndi zochita zakunja!
advice.moderate: Pakati. Anthu owona ayenera kuchepetsa nthawi.
advice.sensitive: Osabwino kwa magulu owona. Valani chophimba ngati kofunika.
insight.good: Mpweya wabwino umayenda bwino chifukwa cha kufalikira kwa mphepo. Zotetezeka pazochita zonse.
insight.moderate: Kuchulukana pang'ono. Mikhalidwe ndi yovomerezeka kwa anthu ambiri.
insight.sensitive: Tinthu tating'ono ting'onoting'ono timene timachokera ku mpweya wa m'deralo. Magulu okhudzidwa ayenera kusamala.
insight.unhealthy: Kukhazikika kwapang'onopang'ono kumawonedwa. Imawonetsa komwe kuyaka komweko.
insight.hazardous: Mpweya woopsa. Khalani m'nyumba ndikugwiritsa ntchito kusefa mpweya ngati n'kotheka.
about.title: Zokhudza Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI imayerekeza PM2.5 tsiku lililonse m'mayiko 54 a ku Africa.
about.overview.problem_desc: Mizinda yambiri ya ku Africa ilibe zida zokuyang'anira mpweya. Timadzaza bwalo limweli.
about.how.intro: Kugwiritsa ntchito data ya satellite ndi kuphunzira kwa makina.
about.how.step1.title: Ma-Satellite monga Sensors
about.how.step1.desc: Kugwiritsa ntchito data ya ESA Sentinel-5P ndi NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Kukonza kwa Pansi
about.how.step2.desc: Modeli yaphunzitsidwa pa malo 398 okuyang'anira m'mayiko 29.
about.how.step3.title: Kuyerekeza kwa Continent
about.how.step3.desc: Modeli ya XGBoost imayerekezetsa PM2.5 ku malo alionse a ku Africa.
about.limit.gap_desc: Kuyenda kwa satellite tsiku lililonse kukhoza kuluza kukulitsa kwakanthawi.
